maximumContextCheckpointsKeptPerSlotWhic: Umubare mwinshi w'amanota y'isuzuma ry'ikiganiro gisigaye ku rubuga, gituma ikiganiro cyahinduwe gisubiramo aho gusubiramo.
minimumNumberOfTokensBetweenContextCheck: Umubare muto wa tokens hagati y'amanota y'isuzuma rya context.
useFullSizeKvCacheForSlidingWindow: Gukoresha uburemere bumwe KV cache for sliding-window-attention models (e.g. Gemma). Enable this if such a model reprocesses the entire prompt every turn instead of reusing cache; costs more memory.
useASingleUnifiedKvBufferSharedAcross: Gukoresha buffer KV imwe ihuriweho ihuriweho n'ibice byose. Gutunganya ububiko bw'amaderese igihe ukoresha ibice binyuranye mu buryo bwa paralele.
capHowMuchOfTheUnifiedKvCache: Gushyiraho umubare munini w'ibanga rihuriweho KV rishobora gukoreshwa n'urupapuro rw'ikoranabuhanga, mu bigaragaza. 0 risiga urupapuro rw'ikoranabuhanga rwihariye kugirango rikoreshe ibanga rihuriweho. Rikoreshwa gusa igihe ibanga rihuriweho.
keepTheReasoningOfEveryEarlierAssistantT: Gushyiramo ibitekerezo by'abakozi bose ba mbere mu butumwa, atari gusa iby'abakozi ba nyuma. Bigira ingaruka ku bagore gusa bakoresha porogaramu y'ikiganiro ishyigikiye iyi gahunda, kandi bitwara tokens z'ibutumwa.
numberOfTokensFromTheInitialPromptTo: Umubare w'ibimenyetso bivuye ku butumwa bwa mbere bigomba gutwarwa igihe inyandiko ihinduwe. -1 = gutwara byose.
automaticallyUnloadOtherModelsWhenLoadin: Gukuraho ayandi mamodoka mu gihe hashyizweho undi mushya
accessTokensProgrammaticallyAuthenticate: Amatoke y'ukwinjira akoresha porogaramu igaragaza ukuri kw'idini ryawe kuri Hugging Face Hub, ifasha porogaramu gukora ibikorwa bijyanye n'ubushobozi bw'uburenganzira bwahawe.
oneOrMoreFilesExceedTheValue0Mb: Umwe cyangwa benshi mu mafaranga barenze ku gipimo cya {{value0}}MB
areYouSureYouWantToRevokeAccess: Niba wifuza gukuraho uburenganzira bwo gukoresha iyi porogaramu, shyiraho indangakintu ya porogaramu ikurikira::
changingTheAuthenticationModeWillAffectH: Guhindura uburyo bw'uburenganzira bw'umukoresha bizagira ingaruka ku buryo abakiliya bakoresha insanganyamatsiko Novera. Ushaka gukomeza?
threadRemovedFromValue0Successfully: Icyo kugaragaza cyashyizwe imbere kuri "{{value0}}" neza
theProvidedHuggingFaceTokenIsInvalidPlea: Indangakintu Hugging Face yagenewe si nziza. Reba indangakintu yawe maze ujye ugerageza.
theValidationRequestTimedOutPleaseCheckY: Ikibazo cy'uburenganzira bwa muntu cyarangije igihe. Reba niba ukoresha porogaramu ikora neza, maze ujye ugerageza.
aNetworkErrorOccurredWhileValidatingTheT: Impanuka y'ikoranabuhanga yagaragaye mu gihe hakorwaga isuzuma ry'ubuziranenge bw'ikimenyetso. Reba niba ukoresha internet.
downloadProgressEmpty: Igihe cyo gushushanya cyawe kizagaragara hano
importModelReadme: Reba dosiye ya porogaramu kugirango umenye lisansi yayo, amagambo ashyigikiwe, memoriye ikenewe n'uburyo ikoreshwa mbere yo gufungura porogaramu.
settingsLanguageHelp: Ibisubizo by’urupapuro rw’ibara ry’umukara biterwa n’ingamba zawe n’amagambo akoreshwa n’urupapuro rw’ibara ry’umukara rw’urupapuro rw’ibara ry’umukara rw’umukara.
apiFallbackHint: Umurongo wa mbere ni #1. Novera retries the next key only after a 401, 403 or 429 response.
unexpectedErrorHelp: Refresh this page or contact support if the problem persists.Ikibazo gishobora kuba gifitanye isano na:
huggingFaceTokenValid: Tokeni yawe Hugging Face ni nziza.
keyRateLimited: Igiciro gishobora kuba kiri hasi cyangwa kitariho (429)
dependencySomeCoreBackendFilesAreMissing: Ibyerekeye ibifayili by'ikoranabuhanga by'ingenzi byarimo cyangwa byarimo ikibazo — ibi bishobora guha igisubizo ko iterambere ry'iterambere ryashyizwe imbere cyangwa ikigero cyashyizwe imbere gusa. Shyira imbere ikoranabuhanga kandi ubyiremeze mu byemezo bya Novera.
dependencyInstallNcclFromTheNvidiaDevelo: Shyira NCCL ku site ya NVIDIA Developer. NCCL ikoreshwa mu gukorana kw'ibikorwa by'ubwoko bw'ibindi GPU.
dependencyInstallNcclViaTheNvidiaPackage: Kwinjiza NCCL binyuze mu ishyirahamwe ry'impapuro NVIDIA. Ku Debian/Ubuntu: sudo apt install libnccl2 libnccl-dev. Reba igishushanyo cy'ishyirwaho rya NVIDIA NCCL cyawe.
dependencyInstallCudnnFromTheNvidiaDevel: Gushyiraho cuDNN kuva ku rubuga rwa NVIDIA Developer na gushyiramo DLLs hamwe n'applikasiyo cyangwa muri System32.
dependencyInstallCudnnViaTheNvidiaPackag: Kwinjiza cuDNN binyuze mu ishyirahamwe ry'impapuro NVIDIA cyangwa gukuraho tarball na gukoporora libs kuri /usr/local/cuda/lib64.
dependencyInstallTheVulkanRuntimeFromLun: Kwinjiza Vulkan Runtime kuva kuri LunarG. Umukoresha wawe wa GPU ashobora kuba yaramaze kuyishyiramo — uhindure umukoresha wawe wa GPU mbere.
dependencyInstallTheVulkanLoaderOnUbuntu: Kwinjiza umutambuka Vulkan: ku Ubuntu/Debian: sudo apt install libvulkan1. ku Arch: sudo pacman -S vulkan-icd-loader. ku RHEL/Fedora: sudo dnf install vulkan-loader.
dependencyInstallTheCudaToolkitFromNvidi: Kwinjiza i CUDA Toolkit kuva kuri NVIDIA. Mu gihe cy'ishyiramo, hitamo "CUDA".
Shyira CUDA Toolkit kuva kuri NVIDIA. Ku Debian/Ubuntu: sudo apt install cuda-toolkit-12. Ku RHEL/Fedora: koresha repo ya NVIDIA.
dependencyInstallTheCudaToolkit11FromNvi: Kwinjiza i CUDA Toolkit 11 kuva kuri NVIDIA. Mu gihe cy'ishyiramo, hitamo "CUDA".
Gushyiraho CUDA Toolkit 11 kuva kuri NVIDIA. Ku Debian/Ubuntu: sudo apt install cuda-toolkit-11. Ku RHEL/Fedora: gukoresha NVIDIA repo.
dependencyInstallTheCudaToolkit12FromNvi: Kwinjiza i CUDA Toolkit 12 kuva kuri NVIDIA. Mu gihe cy'ishyiramo, hitamo "CUDA".
Gushyiraho CUDA Toolkit 12 kuva kuri NVIDIA. Ku Debian/Ubuntu: sudo apt install cuda-toolkit-12. Ku RHEL/Fedora: gukoresha NVIDIA repo.
dependencyInstallTheCudaToolkit13FromNvi: Kwinjiza i CUDA Toolkit 13 kuva kuri NVIDIA. Mu gihe cy'ishyiramo, hitamo "CUDA".
Gushyiraho CUDA Toolkit 13 kuva kuri NVIDIA. Ku Debian/Ubuntu: sudo apt install cuda-toolkit-13. Ku RHEL/Fedora: gukoresha NVIDIA repo.
generationCountHint: Guhitamo umubare w'ishusho, ibice by'indirimbo cyangwa videwo kwinjiza (1–10). Icyo ari cyo cyose gikorwa mu buryo bukurikira. Guhagarika bihagarika imirimo isigaye.
reasoningEnabledHint: Reasoning ni ishobora gukoreshwa ku buri butumwa.
reasoningDisabledHint: Reasoning ni yahagaritswe ku buri butumwa.
reasoningDefaultHint: Reasoning ikoresha imiterere isanzwe ya model.
